cnbc.title: Binance says 90% of $6.3 billion hack losses are now covered, plans to resume withdrawals Sunday
cnbc.summary: Binance says it has restored backing for 90% of assets affected by its $6.3 billion hack and is planning to resume withdrawals, subject to security checks.

cnbc.title: Trump defamation suit against Murdoch, WSJ over Epstein letter dismissed with prejudice
cnbc.summary: President Donald Trump denied writing a birthday letter to sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, which was the subject of a 2025 Wall Street Journal article.

cnbc.title: ‘Pop-up’ super PACs pour $637 million into 2026 midterm races
cnbc.summary: Twenty-two late-forming super PACs spent about $637 million in 2026 congressional races, sometimes before voters could see their donors.

cnbc.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
cnbc.summary: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

cnbc.title: SpaceX loses bid to toss NAACP lawsuit over Memphis data center air pollution
cnbc.summary: The Colossus data centers and a power plant that SpaceXAI is also building in Southaven, Mississippi, have faced community backlash for years.

cnbc.title: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
cnbc.summary: The funding round is still in progress and has not closed, so the figures are subject to change, a person directly familiar with the deal told CNBC.

cnbc.title: Trump promised to slash energy costs  — but gasoline, diesel and jet fuel all soared instead
cnbc.summary: President Donald Trump promised voters who were angry about inflation that he would slash gasoline prices below $2 a gallon in his first year in office.

cnbc.title: Anthropic's path to the Nasdaq just got a lot bumpier
cnbc.summary: Concerning projections from hyperscalers this week punished tech stocks and pushed the Nasdaq to its first three-week losing streak since March.

cnbc.title: Automatic 401(k) rollovers reduce cash-outs, research finds — but few accounts reach new employer plans
cnbc.summary: Workers with small 401(k) balances are cashing out less often under an automatic portability program, but most accounts remain in temporary IRAs.
